title: Comprehensive perspectives of metal and metal-free C–H activation approaches in pyrimidines and related heteroarenes: scope, mechanistic insights, and synthetic utility
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42121-42175
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07044A, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Amin Mirfarah, Soodabeh Hatami, Ali Shiri
Pyrimidine C–H activation can be efficiently achieved through three complementary strategies: metal-catalyzed, metal-free, and photochemical approaches enabling direct functionalization and structural diversification of heteroaromatic frameworks.
